purpose: Hook-driven pop, internet-native AI pop, comic songs, and high-concept short-form visual language.

rules.verse: rotate 2-4 visual devices while preserving character/world continuity
rules.pre_chorus: increase density or withhold the signature hook image
rules.chorus: repeat a recognizable visual signature so the hook has a look
rules.instrumental: use graphic abstraction, dance-like motion, collage, or fast motif variation
rules.final_chorus: combine the strongest earlier devices rather than introducing a new world
rules.outro: land a visual punchline, icon, or clean final pose
